dedupe_keys.name: resourcetrade earth chatham house resource trade database

description: A database and interactive site of international trade in natural resources. The about page says it covers bilateral trade between more than 200 countries and territories in more than 1,350 resources, including ores, metals, fossil fuels, agricultural and forestry products, in value and mass, built from UN Comtrade data classified in HS1996 with cleaning and gap filling, and that it adds estimates of land and water embodied in trade for 2000 to 2015 and embodied CO2. The site is free to use and data can be downloaded after registration. Coverage is world trade flows by exporter and importer. Caveats: the page read does not give the licence text, and mirror trade and confidential flows limit accuracy for some commodities. For simulation it gives country-to-country flows of minerals, energy and food to model how export bans, conflicts or disasters in producing countries spread through supply chains. A related catalogue record is UN Comtrade.
